_comment: Starter data for yt-discover. This file is DATA, not code. Edit it, then copy to ~/.config/yt-discover/seed.json and use Tune -> 'Reload seed.json' (additive, safe to repeat). Topics may be plain strings (intent defaults to 'learning') or objects with {text, intent}. 'intent' is a free-text tag; day parts below decide which intents are visible at which hours. Nothing here overrides your UI edits unless you reload.

core.text: stop motion animation behind the scenes

neighbour.text: how old video games were made

settings._comment: See config.py DEFAULTS. Unverified YouTube API details are marked TODO below.
settings.TODO_search_quota_model: Google's current quota page says search.list has a separate bucket of 100 calls/day at 1 unit each, while older docs described 100 units per call. Both rails are tracked. Verify at https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/determine_quota_cost
settings.TODO_relatedToVideoId: Removed 2023-08-07 per revision history. Not used anywhere in this app.
settings.TODO_key_billing: Verify in Google Cloud Console whether your project needs a billing account; the API has a free quota but Google's signup flow can still ask for a card.
